# Third-Party Notices — Gate 00 Baseline

Status: **inventory complete; license/compliance not clean**.

This baseline is an engineering inventory, not legal approval and not yet the
final notice shipped with an application. Distribution must remain blocked
until the findings below are resolved and the applicable license texts and
vendor terms have been reviewed.

## Upstream source

- Audius apps: `https://github.com/AudiusProject/apps.git`
- Candidate source commit: `57144304c433abdd344c0d07c37c26c31c71da9b`
- Declared repository license: Apache-2.0
- Preserved license text: repository-root `LICENSE`

## Machine-readable inventories

- `NPM_LICENSES.lock.json`: every exact npm package occurrence parsed from the
  root npm lockfile, deduplicated records, declared license values, resolved
  URLs, and integrity hashes.
- `NATIVE_DEPENDENCIES.lock.json`: CocoaPods lock records, Android direct
  dependency declarations, Gradle lock status, and the vendored AAR checksum.
- `SBOM.cdx.json`: reproducible CycloneDX 1.6 npm dependency graph generated by
  `@cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm` 6.0.0 in package-lock-only mode.

The npm lock contains 10,557 dependency occurrences and 6,349 unique
name/version records. Of those occurrences, 706 have no license declaration,
one uses structured license metadata, and 155 string declarations mention a
GPL-family identifier. A companion cross-platform media audit counted 168
copyleft-labelled nodes after native items were included. These counts identify
review scope; they do not decide compatibility or distribution obligations.

## Distribution blockers and required review

| Finding | Evidence (values redacted) | Required disposition |
|---|---|---|
| Android release signing material is tracked | `packages/mobile/android/app/my-upload-key.keystore`; password property keys `MYAPP_UPLOAD_STORE_PASSWORD` and `MYAPP_UPLOAD_KEY_PASSWORD` are present | Treat the upload material as compromised, remove it from tracking, rotate credentials, and move secrets to the approved secret manager before release |
| FFmpeg full-gpl binaries are included | Android AAR SHA-256 `87e37384ef5f8755d816212890775ba94d493a70d2eff4615a8d59780ac1fc5e`; iOS podspec says LGPL while naming a full-gpl artifact | Confirm exact linked libraries/configuration and satisfy or remove incompatible obligations before distribution |
| FFmpeg artifact inputs are not reproducible | iOS fetches `latest.zip` without a hash; Android download task performs no checksum verification | Pin immutable source artifacts and verify cryptographic checksums |
| Player native lock drift (resolved in G00-T04) | npm/package metadata and `Podfile.lock` now both resolve `react-native-track-player` 4.1.2; public-mirror macOS run `31557868810` passed strict `pod install --deployment` and the unsigned Release simulator build | Keep `pod install --deployment` enforced; no remaining action is required for this drift finding |
| Android transitive graph is unlocked | No Gradle dependency lock is present; several declarations are dynamic, interpolated, or versionless | Resolve and lock the complete graph, then generate an artifact-level Android SBOM and notices |
| nSure terms/privacy are unresolved | iOS nSure 1.3.13 and Android nSure SDK 1.3.2 are present; the bridge obtains a device identifier; no bundled license, terms, or privacy notice was found | Complete vendor license/terms and privacy review before enabling or shipping |
| Copyleft runtime declarations require review | `pm2` 5.2.0 and `@pm2/agent` 2.0.3 declare AGPL-3.0; `abi-decoder` 2.4.0 declares GPL-3.0; multiple Web3 packages declare LGPL-3.0 | Confirm shipped scope and license compatibility; do not assume hidden or later-removed features are exempt |
| Missing or non-SPDX metadata remains | 706 npm occurrences omit a license declaration and other records use custom/structured declarations | Retrieve authoritative package license texts and normalize only after verification |

## Common declared license families

The largest unique name/version groups are MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0,
BSD-3-Clause, LGPL-3.0, BSD-2-Clause, and MPL-2.0. Exact expressions and counts
are preserved in `NPM_LICENSES.lock.json`; no expression has been rewritten or
silently treated as permissive.

## Regeneration

The Gate 00 npm SBOM command was:

```text
npx --yes npm@11.10.0 exec --yes --package=@cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm@6.0.0 -- cyclonedx-npm --package-lock-only --ignore-npm-errors --output-reproducible --spec-version 1.6 --output-format JSON --output-file third-party/SBOM.cdx.json --validate package.json
```

`--ignore-npm-errors` was necessary because the upstream lock reports existing
peer/tree problems under the pinned npm 11.10.0. The command still validated the generated
CycloneDX document and exited 0. The lockfile itself was not changed and project
dependencies were not installed for this task.

The tracked `packages/mobile/android/app/debug.keystore` is inventoried as a
public development fixture, not as release upload material.
